tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged. A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

236	                self.schedule == PipelineScheduleType.custom_1F1B_V
237	                and self.style != PipelineSplitStyle.v
238	            ):
239	                raise OLMoConfigurationError("custom_1F1B_V requires pipeline split style 'v'")
240	            if (
241	                self.schedule == PipelineScheduleType.custom_interleaved_1F1B
242	                and self.style != PipelineSplitStyle.loop
243	            ):
244	                raise OLMoConfigurationError(
245	                    "custom_interleaved_1F1B requires pipeline split style 'loop'; "
246	                    "use custom_1F1B_V for V-shaped placement"
247	                )
248	            return self.style
249	        else:

252	    def final_stage_rank(self) -> int:
253	        style = self.infer_style()
254	        if style == PipelineSplitStyle.loop:
255	            return self.degree - 1
256	        elif style == PipelineSplitStyle.v:
257	            return 0

261	    def rank_completion_order(self) -> Iterable[int]:
262	        """
263	        The order that ranks within the PP group will complete a batch.
264	        """
265	        style = self.infer_style()
266	        if style == PipelineSplitStyle.loop:
267	            return range(self.degree - 1, -1, -1)
268	        elif style == PipelineSplitStyle.v:
269	            return range(self.degree)

271	            raise NotImplementedError(style)

273	    def stage_ids_this_rank(self, pp_rank: int, num_stages: int) -> Tuple[int, ...]:
274	        """
275	        Compute the stage ids for the stages that will run on this pp rank for either a looped or
276	        V style schedule.
277	        """
278	        style = self.infer_style()
279	        if num_stages % self.degree != 0:
280	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
281	                f"num_stages {num_stages} must be evenly divisible by pipeline size {self.degree}"
282	            )
283	
284	        stages_per_rank = num_stages // self.degree
285	        if style == PipelineSplitStyle.loop:
286	            return tuple(pp_rank + s * self.degree for s in range(stages_per_rank))
287	        elif style == PipelineSplitStyle.v:
288	            assert (
289	                stages_per_rank == 2
290	            ), f"v schedules assume 2 stages per rank, got {stages_per_rank}"
291	            stage_v_pairs = list(
292	                zip(range(self.degree), range(num_stages - 1, self.degree - 1, -1))
293	            )
294	            return stage_v_pairs[pp_rank]
295	        else:
296	            raise NotImplementedError(style)

299	def _parse_cell(op: Any):
300	    """Return (kind, mb) where kind in {'F','B','idle'} and mb is Optional[int]."""
301	    if op is None:
302	        return "idle", None
303	    if isinstance(op, tuple):
304	        # allow e.g. ('F', 7) or ('B', 3)
305	        stage_id, k, mb = op
306	        return (str(k).upper() if k in ("F", "B") else "idle", int(mb))
307	    s = str(op).strip()
308	    if s.lower() == "idle":
309	        return "idle", None
310	    # accept 'F7', 'B12', '1F7', 'stage3B4', etc.
311	    m = re.search(r"([FBfb])\s*([0-9]+)", s)
312	    if m:
313	        return m.group(1).upper(), int(m.group(2))
314	    return "idle", None

485	def get_pipeline_bubble_stats(pp_order: Dict[int, List[Any]]) -> tuple[int, int, float]:
486	    ranks = sorted(pp_order.keys())
487	    if not ranks:
488	        return 0, 0, 0.0
489	    num_steps = max(len(pp_order[rank]) for rank in ranks)
490	    total_slots = len(ranks) * num_steps
491	    idle_slots = 0
492	    for rank in ranks:
493	        row = pp_order[rank]
494	        idle_slots += sum(1 for action in row if action is None)
495	        idle_slots += num_steps - len(row)
496	    bubble_rate = idle_slots / total_slots if total_slots > 0 else 0.0
497	    return idle_slots, total_slots, bubble_rate

509	def get_pipeline_activation_stats(pp_order: Dict[int, List[Any]]) -> dict[int, int]:
510	    """Return peak live activation count per rank from the symbolic table."""
511	    peaks: dict[int, int] = {}
512	    for rank, row in pp_order.items():
513	        live = 0
514	        peak = 0
515	        for action in row:
516	            parts = _schedule_action_parts(action)
517	            if parts is None:
518	                continue
519	            _stage_id, kind, _mb = parts
520	            kind_name = getattr(kind, "name", "")
521	            if kind_name == "FORWARD":
522	                live += 1
523	                peak = max(peak, live)
524	            elif kind_name == "FULL_BACKWARD_CONT":
525	                live -= 1
526	        peaks[rank] = peak
527	    return peaks

530	def get_pipeline_tick_exchange_stats(pp_order: Dict[int, List[Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
531	    """
532	    Count cross-rank dependencies where the consumer starts exactly one schedule
533	    tick after the producer. These edges are legal but can become profiler
534	    bubbles when runtime skew makes the producer finish late.
535	    """
536	    action_times: dict[tuple[int, str, Optional[int]], tuple[int, int]] = {}
537	    max_stage = -1
538	    for rank, row in pp_order.items():
539	        for time_step, action in enumerate(row):
540	            parts = _schedule_action_parts(action)
541	            if parts is None:
542	                continue
543	            stage_id, kind, mb = parts
544	            kind_name = getattr(kind, "name", "")
545	            max_stage = max(max_stage, stage_id)
546	            if kind_name == "FORWARD":
547	                action_times[(stage_id, "F", mb)] = (rank, time_step)
548	            elif kind_name == "FULL_BACKWARD":
549	                action_times[(stage_id, "B", mb)] = (rank, time_step)
550	            elif kind_name == "FULL_BACKWARD_CONT":
551	                action_times[(stage_id, "B_", mb)] = (rank, time_step)
552	
553	    tight_edges: list[tuple[int, int, int, str, int, int, Optional[int], int]] = []
554	    # (producer_time, producer_rank, consumer_rank, kind, producer_stage,
555	    #  consumer_stage, microbatch, consumer_time)
556	    for (stage_id, kind_label, mb), (consumer_rank, consumer_time) in action_times.items():
557	        if kind_label == "F" and stage_id > 0:
558	            producer_key = (stage_id - 1, "F", mb)
559	            edge_kind = "F"
560	            producer_stage = stage_id - 1
561	        elif kind_label == "B" and stage_id < max_stage:
562	            producer_key = (stage_id + 1, "B_", mb)
563	            edge_kind = "B"
564	            producer_stage = stage_id + 1
565	        else:
566	            continue
567	
568	        producer = action_times.get(producer_key)
569	        if producer is None:
570	            continue
571	        producer_rank, producer_time = producer
572	        if producer_rank == consumer_rank:
573	            continue
574	        if consumer_time == producer_time + 1:
575	            tight_edges.append(
576	                (
577	                    producer_time,
578	                    producer_rank,
579	                    consumer_rank,
580	                    edge_kind,
581	                    producer_stage,
582	                    stage_id,
583	                    mb,
584	                    consumer_time,
585	                )
586	            )
587	
588	    edges_by_tick_pair: Counter[tuple[int, int, int]] = Counter(
589	        (producer_time, producer_rank, consumer_rank)
590	        for producer_time, producer_rank, consumer_rank, *_rest in tight_edges
591	    )
592	    bidirectional_ticks = 0
593	    seen_pairs: set[tuple[int, int, int]] = set()
594	    for tick, src_rank, dst_rank in edges_by_tick_pair:
595	        reverse = (tick, dst_rank, src_rank)
596	        key = (tick, min(src_rank, dst_rank), max(src_rank, dst_rank))
597	        if key not in seen_pairs and reverse in edges_by_tick_pair:
598	            seen_pairs.add(key)
599	            bidirectional_ticks += 1
600	
601	    samples = [
602	        (
603	            f"t{producer_time}->{consumer_time} "
604	            f"r{producer_rank}->{consumer_rank} "
605	            f"{producer_stage}{edge_kind}{mb}->{consumer_stage}{edge_kind}{mb}"
606	        )
607	        for (
608	            producer_time,
609	            producer_rank,
610	            consumer_rank,
611	            edge_kind,
612	            producer_stage,
613	            consumer_stage,
614	            mb,
615	            consumer_time,
616	        ) in tight_edges[:12]
617	    ]
618	    return {
619	        "tight_edges": len(tight_edges),
620	        "bidirectional_ticks": bidirectional_ticks,
621	        "samples": samples,
622	    }

747	class PipelineSchedule:
748	    """
749	    Driver for the custom pipeline schedules
750	    (:class:`~olmo_core.train.train_module.transformer.pipeline.pipeline_schedule.CustomScheduleInterleaved1F1B`
751	    and :class:`~olmo_core.train.train_module.transformer.pipeline.pipeline_schedule.CustomSchedule1F1BV`).
752	
753	    .. note::
754	        The standard PyTorch pipeline schedules (``1F1B``, ``Interleaved1F1B``, ``GPipe``, ...) are
755	        not currently wired up for this train module — only the ``custom_*`` schedules are supported.
756	
757	    :param num_microbatches: How many microbatches to split the global training batch into. The
758	        global training batch size must be evenly divisible by this. If not specified, the default
759	        will be the number of pipeline stages.
760	    """
761	
762	    def __init__(
763	        self,
764	        *,
765	        model_parts: List[nn.Module],
766	        stages: List[PipelineStage],
767	        pp_mesh: DeviceMesh,
768	        schedule_name: PipelineScheduleType,
769	        loss_fn: Optional[Callable[[Any, torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]] = None,
770	        num_microbatches: Optional[int] = None,
771	        forward_pull_ahead_extra_activations: Optional[List[int]] = None,
772	        save_plot: bool = False,
773	        plot_dir: Optional[str] = None,
774	    ):
775	        self.model_parts = model_parts
776	        self.stages = stages
777	        self.pp_mesh = pp_mesh
778	        self.loss_fn = loss_fn
779	
780	        if schedule_name == PipelineScheduleType.custom_1F1B:

917	            self.schedule_impl.reset_n_microbatches(old_num_microbatches)

45

47

49	    h_out = h_in // world_size

52	    input_split = input_.view(B, t_local, world_size, h_out, d_in).permute(2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
53	    input_split = input_split.flatten(0, 3)
54	
55	    exchanged = all_to_all_single(cp_group, input_split)
56	
57	    # [CP, B, T/CP, H/CP, D] -> [B, CP, T/CP, H/CP, D] -> [B, T, H/CP, D]

70	    """
71	    Transform multiple tensors from context-parallel to head-parallel partitioning via a single AlltoAll.

76	        partitioned along the sequence dimension across context parallel ranks. 3D inputs are

80	        (matching input dimensionality), partitioned along the head dimension.
81	    """
82	    if not inputs:
83	        return []
84	
85	    assert inputs[0].dim() in (
86	        3,

89	    inputs_were_3d = inputs[0].dim() == 3
90	    if inputs_were_3d:

92	
93	    world_size = get_world_size(cp_group)
94	
95	    # Validate and prepare all inputs: split each tensor into CP chunks
96	    prepared = []
97	    shapes = []
98	    for input_ in inputs:
99	        B, t_local, h_in, d_in = input_.shape
100	        h_out = h_in // world_size
101	        shapes.append((B, t_local, h_out, d_in))
102	
103	        # [B, T/CP, H, D] -> [B, T/CP, CP, H/CP, D] -> [CP, B, T/CP, H/CP, D]
104	        input_split = input_.view(B, t_local, world_size, h_out, d_in).permute(2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
105	        prepared.append(input_split)

108	    # input_list[r] contains all chunks destined for rank r, concatenated

110	    input_list = [torch.cat([p[r].flatten() for p in prepared], dim=0) for r in range(world_size)]
111

119	            for r in range(world_size)
120	        ]

from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from olmo_core.config import Config
from olmo_core.distributed.nn import all_to_all, all_to_all_single
from olmo_core.distributed.utils import get_world_size


@dataclass
class ContextParallelConfig(Config):
    """
    Configuration class for context parallelism (CP).
    """

    degree: int
    """
    The CP degree.
    """


def all_to_all_single_cp2hp(
    input_: torch.Tensor, cp_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Transform a tensor from context-parallel to head-parallel partitioning via AlltoAll.

    Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/megatron/core/ssm/mamba_context_parallel.py#L287

    :param input_: The input tensor with shape ``[B, T/CP, H, D]`` or ``[B, T/CP, H]``, partitioned
        along the sequence dimension across context parallel ranks. 3D inputs are treated as having
        D=1 (i.e., ``[B, T/CP, H, 1]``).
    :param cp_group: The process group for context parallel communication.
    :returns: The output tensor with shape ``[B, T, H/CP, D]`` or ``[B, T, H/CP]`` (matching input
        dimensionality), partitioned along the head dimension.
    """
    assert input_.dim() in (
        3,
        4,
    ), "all_to_all_single_cp2hp expects 3-d input shape [B, T/CP, H] or 4-d input shape [B, T/CP, H, D]."

210	        B, t_full, h_in, d_in = input_.shape
211	        t_out = t_full // world_size
212	        shapes.append((B, t_out, h_in, d_in))
213	
214	        # [B, T, H/CP, D] -> [B, CP, T/CP, H/CP, D] -> [CP, B, T/CP, H/CP, D]
215	        input_split = input_.view(B, world_size, t_out, h_in, d_in).permute(1, 0, 2, 3, 4)
216	        prepared.append(input_split)
217	
218	    # Build input list for all_to_all: concatenate chunks for each rank across all tensors
219	    # input_list[r] contains all chunks destined for rank r, concatenated
220	    chunk_size = prepared[0][0].numel()
221	    input_list = [torch.cat([p[r].flatten() for p in prepared], dim=0) for r in range(world_size)]
222	
223	    output_list = all_to_all(cp_group, input_list)
224	
225	    # Split received data back into individual tensors and reshape
226	    outputs = []
227	    for i, (B, t_out, h_in, d_in) in enumerate(shapes):
228	        chunks = [
229	            output_list[r][i * chunk_size : (i + 1) * chunk_size].view(B, t_out, h_in, d_in)
230	            for r in range(world_size)
231	        ]
232	        out = torch.stack(chunks, dim=0).permute(1, 2, 0, 3, 4)
233	        out = out.reshape(B, t_out, h_in * world_size, d_in)
234	        outputs.append(out)
235	
236	    if inputs_were_3d:
237	        outputs = [out.squeeze(-1) for out in outputs]  # [B, T/CP, H, 1] -> [B, T/CP, H]
238	
239	    return outputs

243	    input_: torch.Tensor, cp_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup
244	) -> torch.Tensor:
245	    """
246	    Transform a packed QKV tensor from context-parallel to head-parallel partitioning via AlltoAll.

248	    :param input_: The input tensor with shape ``[B, T/CP, 3, H, D]``, partitioned along

import logging
from typing import Literal, Optional, Tuple

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.distributed import DeviceMesh
from torch.distributed.tensor import Partial, Placement, Replicate, Shard
from torch.distributed.tensor.parallel import (
    PrepareModuleInput,
    PrepareModuleOutput,
    parallelize_module,
)

from olmo_core.distributed.utils import get_full_tensor, get_local_tensor

from .functional import cross_entropy_loss

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class _CELossFnWrapper(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ignore_index: int = -100,
        reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = "mean",
        z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.ignore_index = ignore_index
        self.reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = reduction
        self.z_loss_multiplier = z_loss_multiplier
        self.base_loss_fn = cross_entropy_loss
        self.tp_enabled = False

    def forward(
        self,
        logits: torch.Tensor,
        labels: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
        if logits.shape[:-1] != labels.shape:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"expected labels to have shape {logits.shape[:-1]}, but found {tuple(labels.shape)} instead"
            )

        # shape: (B * S, V)
        logits_for_loss = logits.view(-1, logits.shape[-1])

        # shape: (B, S) -> (B * S,)
        labels_for_loss = labels.view(-1)

        ce_loss, z_loss = self.base_loss_fn(
            logits_for_loss,
            labels_for_loss,
            ignore_index=self.ignore_index,
            reduction="sum" if self.tp_enabled and self.reduction == "mean" else self.reduction,
            compute_z_loss=self.z_loss_multiplier is not None,
            z_loss_multiplier=self.z_loss_multiplier or 1e-4,
        )

        if self.reduction == "none":
            ce_loss = ce_loss.view(labels.shape)
            if z_loss is not None:
                z_loss = z_loss.view(labels.shape)
        elif self.tp_enabled:
            ce_loss = ce_loss.unsqueeze(0)
            if z_loss is not None:
                z_loss = z_loss.unsqueeze(0)

        return ce_loss, z_loss


class CrossEntropyLoss(nn.Module):
    """
    Cross-entropy loss.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        ignore_index: int = -100,
        reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = "mean",
        z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float] = None,
        compile: bool = False,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.loss_fn = _CELossFnWrapper(
            ignore_index=ignore_index,
            reduction=reduction,
            z_loss_multiplier=z_loss_multiplier,
        )
        self._tp_enabled = False

        self._compile_enabled = False
        if compile:
            if torch.cuda.is_available():
                log.info("Compiling loss function...")
                self.compile()
                self._compile_enabled = True
            else:
                log.warning("Skipping loss compilation since CUDA is not available")

    @property
    def compile_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self._compile_enabled

    @property
    def tp_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self._tp_enabled

    @property
    def z_loss_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self.loss_fn.z_loss_multiplier is not None

    @property
    def reduction(self) -> Literal["sum", "mean", "none"]:
        return self.loss_fn.reduction

    def forward(
        self,
        logits: torch.Tensor,
        labels: torch.Tensor,
        div_factor: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
        """
        Compute the CE loss and optionally Z-loss.

        :param logits: The logits of shape ``(B, S, V)``.
        :param labels: The target labels of shape ``(B, S)``.
        """
        ce_loss, z_loss = self.loss_fn(get_local_tensor(logits), get_local_tensor(labels))

        if self.tp_enabled and self.reduction != "none":
            # Sum the per-rank losses before normalizing. Averaging per-rank means would
            # weight shards equally even when their numbers of valid tokens differ.
            ce_loss = ce_loss.sum()
            if z_loss is not None:
                z_loss = z_loss.sum()
            if self.reduction == "mean":
                num_valid_tokens = get_full_tensor((labels != self.loss_fn.ignore_index).sum())
                ce_loss = ce_loss / num_valid_tokens
                if z_loss is not None:
                    z_loss = z_loss / num_valid_tokens

        if div_factor is not None:
            ce_loss = ce_loss / div_factor
            if z_loss is not None:
                z_loss = z_loss / div_factor

        return ce_loss, z_loss

    def apply_tp(
        self,
        tp_mesh: DeviceMesh,
        input_layouts: Optional[Tuple[Placement, ...]] = None,
        shard_dimension: int = 1,
        output_layout: Optional[Placement] = None,
        use_local_output: bool = False,
    ):
        desired_input_layouts: Tuple[Placement, ...]
        if input_layouts is None or len(input_layouts) == 3:
            desired_input_layouts = (Shard(shard_dimension), Shard(shard_dimension), Replicate())
        elif len(input_layouts) == 2:
            desired_input_layouts = (Shard(shard_dimension), Shard(shard_dimension))
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"expected 2 or 3 input layouts, found {len(input_layouts)}")
        parallelize_module(
            self,
            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleInput(
                input_layouts=input_layouts,  # type: ignore
                desired_input_layouts=desired_input_layouts,  # type: ignore
                use_local_output=False,
            ),
        )

        inner_output_layout = Shard(shard_dimension) if self.reduction == "none" else Shard(0)
        parallelize_module(
            self.loss_fn,
            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleOutput(
                output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
                    inner_output_layout,
                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else inner_output_layout,
                ),
                desired_output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
                    inner_output_layout,
                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else inner_output_layout,
                ),
                use_local_output=False,
            ),
        )

        # Reducing a sharded loss produces a partial sum, which must be reduced across ranks
        # before returning a replicated (or local) loss. Declaring it replicated skips that step.
        expected_output_layout = Shard(shard_dimension) if self.reduction == "none" else Partial()
        desired_output_layout = output_layout or Replicate()
        parallelize_module(
            self,
            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleOutput(
                output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
                    expected_output_layout,
                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else expected_output_layout,
                ),
                desired_output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
                    desired_output_layout,
                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else desired_output_layout,
                ),
                use_local_output=use_local_output,
            ),
        )

        self._tp_enabled = True
        self.loss_fn.tp_enabled = True

21	class _CELossFnWrapper(nn.Module):
22	    def __init__(
23	        self,
24	        ignore_index: int = -100,
25	        reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = "mean",
26	        z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float] = None,
27	    ):
28	        super().__init__()
29	        self.ignore_index = ignore_index
30	        self.reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = reduction
31	        self.z_loss_multiplier = z_loss_multiplier
32	        self.base_loss_fn = cross_entropy_loss
33	        self.tp_enabled = False
34	
35	    def forward(
36	        self,
37	        logits: torch.Tensor,
38	        labels: torch.Tensor,
39	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
40	        if logits.shape[:-1] != labels.shape:
41	            raise RuntimeError(
42	                f"expected labels to have shape {logits.shape[:-1]}, but found {tuple(labels.shape)} instead"
43	            )
44	
45	        # shape: (B * S, V)
46	        logits_for_loss = logits.view(-1, logits.shape[-1])
47	
48	        # shape: (B, S) -> (B * S,)
49	        labels_for_loss = labels.view(-1)
50	
51	        ce_loss, z_loss = self.base_loss_fn(
52	            logits_for_loss,
53	            labels_for_loss,
54	            ignore_index=self.ignore_index,
55	            reduction="sum" if self.tp_enabled and self.reduction == "mean" else self.reduction,
56	            compute_z_loss=self.z_loss_multiplier is not None,
57	            z_loss_multiplier=self.z_loss_multiplier or 1e-4,
58	        )
59	
60	        if self.reduction == "none":
61	            ce_loss = ce_loss.view(labels.shape)
62	            if z_loss is not None:
63	                z_loss = z_loss.view(labels.shape)
64	        elif self.tp_enabled:
65	            ce_loss = ce_loss.unsqueeze(0)
66	            if z_loss is not None:
67	                z_loss = z_loss.unsqueeze(0)
68	
69	        return ce_loss, z_loss

72	class CrossEntropyLoss(nn.Module):
73	    """
74	    Cross-entropy loss.
75	    """
76	
77	    def __init__(
78	        self,
79	        *,
80	        ignore_index: int = -100,
81	        reduction: Literal["mean", "sum", "none"] = "mean",
82	        z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float] = None,
83	        compile: bool = False,
84	    ):
85	        super().__init__()
86	
87	        self.loss_fn = _CELossFnWrapper(
88	            ignore_index=ignore_index,
89	            reduction=reduction,
90	            z_loss_multiplier=z_loss_multiplier,
91	        )
92	        self._tp_enabled = False
93	
94	        self._compile_enabled = False
95	        if compile:
96	            if torch.cuda.is_available():
97	                log.info("Compiling loss function...")
98	                self.compile()
99	                self._compile_enabled = True
100	            else:
101	                log.warning("Skipping loss compilation since CUDA is not available")
102	
103	    @property
104	    def compile_enabled(self) -> bool:
105	        return self._compile_enabled
106	
107	    @property
108	    def tp_enabled(self) -> bool:
109	        return self._tp_enabled
110	
111	    @property
112	    def z_loss_enabled(self) -> bool:
113	        return self.loss_fn.z_loss_multiplier is not None
114	
115	    @property
116	    def reduction(self) -> Literal["sum", "mean", "none"]:
117	        return self.loss_fn.reduction
118	
119	    def forward(
120	        self,
121	        logits: torch.Tensor,
122	        labels: torch.Tensor,
123	        div_factor: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
124	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
125	        """
126	        Compute the CE loss and optionally Z-loss.
127	
128	        :param logits: The logits of shape ``(B, S, V)``.
129	        :param labels: The target labels of shape ``(B, S)``.
130	        """
131	        ce_loss, z_loss = self.loss_fn(get_local_tensor(logits), get_local_tensor(labels))
132	
133	        if self.tp_enabled and self.reduction != "none":
134	            # Sum the per-rank losses before normalizing. Averaging per-rank means would
135	            # weight shards equally even when their numbers of valid tokens differ.
136	            ce_loss = ce_loss.sum()
137	            if z_loss is not None:
138	                z_loss = z_loss.sum()
139	            if self.reduction == "mean":
140	                num_valid_tokens = get_full_tensor((labels != self.loss_fn.ignore_index).sum())
141	                ce_loss = ce_loss / num_valid_tokens
142	                if z_loss is not None:
143	                    z_loss = z_loss / num_valid_tokens
144	
145	        if div_factor is not None:
146	            ce_loss = ce_loss / div_factor
147	            if z_loss is not None:
148	                z_loss = z_loss / div_factor
149	
150	        return ce_loss, z_loss
151	
152	    def apply_tp(
153	        self,
154	        tp_mesh: DeviceMesh,
155	        input_layouts: Optional[Tuple[Placement, ...]] = None,
156	        shard_dimension: int = 1,
157	        output_layout: Optional[Placement] = None,
158	        use_local_output: bool = False,
159	    ):
160	        desired_input_layouts: Tuple[Placement, ...]
161	        if input_layouts is None or len(input_layouts) == 3:
162	            desired_input_layouts = (Shard(shard_dimension), Shard(shard_dimension), Replicate())
163	        elif len(input_layouts) == 2:
164	            desired_input_layouts = (Shard(shard_dimension), Shard(shard_dimension))
165	        else:
166	            raise ValueError(f"expected 2 or 3 input layouts, found {len(input_layouts)}")
167	        parallelize_module(
168	            self,
169	            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
170	            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleInput(
171	                input_layouts=input_layouts,  # type: ignore
172	                desired_input_layouts=desired_input_layouts,  # type: ignore
173	                use_local_output=False,
174	            ),
175	        )
176	
177	        inner_output_layout = Shard(shard_dimension) if self.reduction == "none" else Shard(0)
178	        parallelize_module(
179	            self.loss_fn,
180	            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
181	            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleOutput(
182	                output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
183	                    inner_output_layout,
184	                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else inner_output_layout,
185	                ),
186	                desired_output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
187	                    inner_output_layout,
188	                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else inner_output_layout,
189	                ),
190	                use_local_output=False,
191	            ),
192	        )
193	
194	        # Reducing a sharded loss produces a partial sum, which must be reduced across ranks
195	        # before returning a replicated (or local) loss. Declaring it replicated skips that step.
196	        expected_output_layout = Shard(shard_dimension) if self.reduction == "none" else Partial()
197	        desired_output_layout = output_layout or Replicate()
198	        parallelize_module(
199	            self,
200	            device_mesh=tp_mesh,
201	            parallelize_plan=PrepareModuleOutput(
202	                output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
203	                    expected_output_layout,
204	                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else expected_output_layout,
205	                ),
206	                desired_output_layouts=(  # type: ignore
207	                    desired_output_layout,
208	                    None if not self.z_loss_enabled else desired_output_layout,
209	                ),
210	                use_local_output=use_local_output,
211	            ),
212	        )
213	
214	        self._tp_enabled = True
215	        self.loss_fn.tp_enabled = True

import logging
from typing import List, Optional, TypeVar, cast

import torch
from torch.distributed import DeviceMesh

from olmo_core.distributed.parallel import (
    DataParallelType,
    get_cp_mesh,
    get_device_mesh_info,
    get_dp_model_mesh,
    get_ep_mesh,
    get_pp_mesh,
    get_tp_mesh,
)
from olmo_core.exceptions import OLMoConfigurationError
from olmo_core.float8 import Float8Config
from olmo_core.nn.transformer import MoETransformer, Transformer

from .config import (
    TransformerActivationCheckpointingConfig,
    TransformerContextParallelConfig,
    TransformerDataParallelConfig,
    TransformerExpertParallelConfig,
    TransformerTensorParallelConfig,
)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


M = TypeVar("M", Transformer, List[Transformer])


def parallelize_model(
    model: M,
    *,
    world_mesh: Optional[DeviceMesh],
    device: torch.device,
    max_sequence_length: Optional[int] = None,
    rank_microbatch_size: Optional[int] = None,
    compile_model: bool = False,
    float8_config: Optional[Float8Config] = None,
    dp_config: Optional[TransformerDataParallelConfig] = None,
    tp_config: Optional[TransformerTensorParallelConfig] = None,
    cp_config: Optional[TransformerContextParallelConfig] = None,
    ep_config: Optional[TransformerExpertParallelConfig] = None,
    ac_config: Optional[TransformerActivationCheckpointingConfig] = None,
    pp_enabled: bool = False,
) -> M:
    model_parts: List[Transformer] = [model] if isinstance(model, Transformer) else model

    pp_mesh: Optional[DeviceMesh] = None
    if pp_enabled:
        assert world_mesh is not None
        pp_mesh = get_pp_mesh(world_mesh)
        for m in model_parts:
            m.apply_pp(pp_mesh)

    # Maybe apply FP8 training.
    if float8_config is not None and float8_config.enabled:
        for m in model_parts:
            m.apply_fp8(float8_config)
            log.info("Swapped linear layers to Float8 linear layers\n%s", m)

    # Maybe apply context parallelism.
    if cp_config is not None:
        assert world_mesh is not None
        cp_mesh = get_cp_mesh(world_mesh)
        for m in model_parts:
            m.apply_cp(cp_mesh, ring=cp_config.ring, uly=cp_config.uly)
        log.info(f"Applied context parallelism to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(cp_mesh)}")

    # Maybe apply tensor.
    if tp_config is not None:
        if ep_config is not None:
            raise NotImplementedError("TP + EP is not implemented yet")
        assert world_mesh is not None
        tp_mesh = get_tp_mesh(world_mesh)
        for m in model_parts:
            m.apply_tp(tp_mesh)
        tp_config.maybe_enable_async_tp(tp_mesh)
        log.info(f"Applied tensor parallelism to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(tp_mesh)}")

    # Maybe apply expert parallelism.
    if ep_config is not None:
        assert world_mesh is not None
        ep_mesh = get_ep_mesh(world_mesh)
        for m in model_parts:
            if not m.is_moe:
                raise OLMoConfigurationError("Expert parallelism is only valid for MoE models")
            cast(MoETransformer, m).apply_ep(ep_mesh)
        log.info(f"Applied expert parallelism to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(ep_mesh)}")

    # Maybe apply activation checkpointing.
    if ac_config is not None:
        for m in model_parts:
            m.apply_activation_checkpointing(
                ac_config.mode,
                block_interval=ac_config.block_interval,
                modules=ac_config.modules,
                activation_memory_budget=ac_config.activation_memory_budget,
                determinism_check=ac_config.determinism_check,
            )
        log.info(f"Applied '{ac_config.mode}' activation checkpointing to the model")

    # Maybe compile.
    if compile_model:
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            for m in model_parts:
                m.apply_compile()
            log.info("Applied torch.compile() to the model")
        else:
            log.warning("Skipping model compilation since CUDA is not available")

    # Maybe shard/replicate according to data parallel config.
    if dp_config is not None:
        assert world_mesh is not None
        dp_mesh = get_dp_model_mesh(world_mesh)
        param_dtype = dp_config.param_dtype.as_pt() if dp_config.param_dtype is not None else None
        if dp_config.name in (DataParallelType.fsdp, DataParallelType.hsdp):
            for m in model_parts:
                if m.is_moe:
                    cast(MoETransformer, m).prepare_experts_for_fsdp(
                        world_mesh,
                        param_dtype=param_dtype,
                        reduce_dtype=dp_config.reduce_dtype.as_pt(),
                        pp_enabled=pp_enabled,
                    )
                m.apply_fsdp(
                    dp_mesh=dp_mesh,
                    param_dtype=param_dtype,
                    reduce_dtype=dp_config.reduce_dtype.as_pt(),
                    wrapping_strategy=dp_config.wrapping_strategy,
                    pp_enabled=pp_enabled,
                    prefetch_factor=dp_config.prefetch_factor,
                )
            log.info(f"Applied FSDP to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(dp_mesh)}")
        elif dp_config.name == DataParallelType.ddp:
            for m in model_parts:
                if m.is_moe:
                    cast(MoETransformer, m).prepare_experts_for_ddp(world_mesh)
                m.apply_ddp(dp_mesh=dp_mesh, compile_enabled=compile_model, param_dtype=param_dtype)
            log.info(f"Applied DDP to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(dp_mesh)}")
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(dp_config.name)

    # Materialize and init parameters.
    log.info("Initializing model weights...")
    for model_part_idx, m in enumerate(model_parts):
        m.init_weights(
            max_seq_len=max_sequence_length,
            max_local_microbatch_size=rank_microbatch_size,
            device=device,
            world_mesh=world_mesh,
            model_part_idx=model_part_idx,
        )

    return model

Author: Akshita Bhagia <akshita23bhagia@gmail.com>

    Consolidate DDP tests and fix tensor-parallel loss reduction (#883)
    
    Consolidate duplicated checkpoint and DDP tests, and fix a
    tensor-parallel cross-entropy reduction bug exposed by correcting an
    ineffective test assertion.
    
    For summed TP loss, the output hook declared the result replicated even
    though it could still be a partial sum. This skipped the required
    all-reduce and returned a rank-local loss (observed 3.032972 versus the
    6.129296 reference on GPUs). Declare the reduced output `Partial()` so
    it is redistributed before being returned. Keep the expected reference
    loss separate in the test and cover sum/mean/none reductions,
    normalization on/off, and z-loss on/off. For mean reduction, sum local
    losses and divide by the global valid-token count so uneven ignore
    counts (including a fully ignored shard) preserve the reference loss and
    gradients. Add z-loss out-of-place to avoid modifying an autograd view.
    
    Test consolidation:
    - Remove two exact duplicate output-discard checkpoint tests under MoE
    v2. Parameterize generic linear-chain, 3D-view, and Python-fallback
    cases, retaining native-storage, FFN, and router-specific coverage.
    - Consolidate four EP/no-EP parity tests into synchronous FP32 and
    rowwise BF16 cases. Preserve the strictest tolerances, global
    expert-gradient comparison, GPU requirements, and zero-drop assertion.
    - Share DDP block/mesh/initialization/router helpers across no-EP,
    no-sync, and parity suites. Preserve differing capacity defaults and
    block/routed-expert FP8 overrides. Keep distinct accounting/shared-only
    tests.

    `akshitab/scheduler-alias-cleanup`.

116	def build_world_mesh(
117	    *,
118	    dp: Optional[DataParallelConfig] = None,
119	    tp: Optional[TensorParallelConfig] = None,
120	    cp: Optional[ContextParallelConfig] = None,
121	    pp: Optional[PipelineParallelConfig] = None,
122	    ep: Optional[ExpertParallelConfig] = None,
123	    device_type: Optional[str] = None,
124	) -> DeviceMesh:
125	    """
126	    Build a :class:`~torch.distributed.device_mesh.DeviceMesh` suitable for the given parallel strategies.
127	
128	    .. seealso::
129	        Pass the mesh created by this function to any of the ``get_*_mesh()`` functions in
130	        this module to get the right sub-mesh for a any given parallel strategy.
131	
132	        - :func:`get_dp_model_mesh()` gives you the 1 or 2D sub-mesh suitable for data parallel *model*
133	          wrappers like FSDP(2) or DDP.
134	        - :func:`get_dp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh suitable for configuring *data loaders*.
135	        - :func:`get_tp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for tensor parallelism.
136	        - :func:`get_cp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for context parallelism.
137	        - :func:`get_pp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for pipeline parallelism.
138	        - :func:`get_ep_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for expert parallelism.
139	
140	    .. important::
141	        A data parallel config is required if any other parallel config is set.
142	
143	    .. important::
144	        Not all parallel strategies are compatible with each other.
145	
146	    :param dp: Data parallel config.
147	    :param tp: Tensor parallel config.
148	    :param cp: Context parallel config.
149	    :param pp: Pipeline parallel config.
150	    :param ep: Expert parallel config.
151	    :param device_type: The device type.
152	
153	    :returns: The world mesh with a shape compatible with the given parallel configs.
154	    """
155	    global _WORLD_MESH
156	
157	    if _WORLD_MESH is not None:
158	        raise RuntimeError("world mesh already exists! You can only call 'build_world_mesh' once!")
159	
160	    device_type = device_type or get_default_device().type
161	    dp_world_size = get_world_size()
162	
163	    if pp is None and tp is None and cp is None and dp is None and ep is None:
164	        return init_device_mesh(device_type, (dp_world_size,), mesh_dim_names=(MeshDimName.dp,))
165	
166	    if dp is None:
167	        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
168	            "Data parallel config is required in addition to expert/tensor/context/pipeline parallel configs"
169	        )
170	
171	    # Validate parallelism degrees while adjust the DP degree.
172	    if pp is not None:
173	        if pp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % pp.degree != 0:
174	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
175	                f"{pp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
176	            )
177	        dp_world_size //= pp.degree
178	    if cp is not None:
179	        if cp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % cp.degree != 0:
180	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
181	                f"{cp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
182	            )
183	        dp_world_size //= cp.degree
184	    if tp is not None:
185	        if tp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % tp.degree != 0:
186	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
187	                f"{tp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
188	            )
189	        dp_world_size //= tp.degree
190	    if ep is not None:
191	        if ep.degree == 0 or dp_world_size % ep.degree != 0:
192	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
193	                f"{ep.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
194	            )
195	        if tp is not None:
196	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
197	                "expert parallelism is mutually exclusive with tensor parallism"
198	            )
199	        # With HSDP we just reuse the 'dp_shard' dimension for expert sharding.
200	        if dp.name != DataParallelType.hsdp:
201	            dp_world_size //= ep.degree
202	
203	            # TODO: remove this restriction once DTensor supports cross-mesh operations.
204	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
205	                "expert parallelism can currently only be used with HSDP data parallelism"
206	            )
207	
208	    # Build up mesh dimensions.
209	    names: List[str] = []
210	    dims: List[int] = []
211	
212	    # Pipeline parallel first.
213	    if pp is not None:
214	        names.append(MeshDimName.pp)
215	        dims.append(pp.degree)
216	
217	    # Then data parallel.
218	    if dp.name == DataParallelType.hsdp:
219	        num_replicas, shard_degree = dp.get_replicate_and_shard_degree(dp_world_size)
220	        names.append(MeshDimName.dp_replicate)
221	        dims.append(num_replicas)
222	        names.append(MeshDimName.dp_shard)
223	        dims.append(shard_degree)
224	
225	        # Expert parallel.
226	        if ep is not None:
227	            # We just reuse the 'dp_shard' dimension for expert sharding.
228	            if ep.degree >= 0 and ep.degree != shard_degree:

231	                )

"""
    Context parallel (CP).
    """

    pp = "pp"
    """
    Pipeline parallel (PP).
    """

    ep = "ep"
    """
    Expert parallel (EP).
    """

    ep_replicate = "ep_replicate"
    ep_shard = "ep_shard"

    dp_ep = "dp_ep"
    dp_cp = "dp_cp"

    # For OLMoDDPTrainModule.
    ep_mp = "ep_mp"  # EP for model parallelism (sharding the model's experts).
    ep_dp = "ep_dp"  # EP for data parallelism (gradient reduction).


_WORLD_MESH: Optional[DeviceMesh] = None


def get_world_mesh() -> Optional[DeviceMesh]:
    """
    Get the global world mesh built with :meth:`build_world_mesh()`.
    """
    global _WORLD_MESH
    return _WORLD_MESH


def build_world_mesh(
    *,
    dp: Optional[DataParallelConfig] = None,
    tp: Optional[TensorParallelConfig] = None,
    cp: Optional[ContextParallelConfig] = None,
    pp: Optional[PipelineParallelConfig] = None,
    ep: Optional[ExpertParallelConfig] = None,
    device_type: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DeviceMesh:
    """
    Build a :class:`~torch.distributed.device_mesh.DeviceMesh` suitable for the given parallel strategies.

    .. seealso::
        Pass the mesh created by this function to any of the ``get_*_mesh()`` functions in
        this module to get the right sub-mesh for a any given parallel strategy.

        - :func:`get_dp_model_mesh()` gives you the 1 or 2D sub-mesh suitable for data parallel *model*
          wrappers like FSDP(2) or DDP.
        - :func:`get_dp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh suitable for configuring *data loaders*.
        - :func:`get_tp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for tensor parallelism.
        - :func:`get_cp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for context parallelism.
        - :func:`get_pp_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for pipeline parallelism.
        - :func:`get_ep_mesh()` gives you the 1D sub-mesh for expert parallelism.

    .. important::
        A data parallel config is required if any other parallel config is set.

    .. important::
        Not all parallel strategies are compatible with each other.

    :param dp: Data parallel config.
    :param tp: Tensor parallel config.
    :param cp: Context parallel config.
    :param pp: Pipeline parallel config.
    :param ep: Expert parallel config.
    :param device_type: The device type.

    :returns: The world mesh with a shape compatible with the given parallel configs.
    """
    global _WORLD_MESH

    if _WORLD_MESH is not None:
        raise RuntimeError("world mesh already exists! You can only call 'build_world_mesh' once!")

    device_type = device_type or get_default_device().type
    dp_world_size = get_world_size()

    if pp is None and tp is None and cp is None and dp is None and ep is None:
        return init_device_mesh(device_type, (dp_world_size,), mesh_dim_names=(MeshDimName.dp,))

    if dp is None:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            "Data parallel config is required in addition to expert/tensor/context/pipeline parallel configs"
        )

    # Validate parallelism degrees while adjust the DP degree.
    if pp is not None:
        if pp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % pp.degree != 0:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"{pp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
            )
        dp_world_size //= pp.degree
    if cp is not None:
        if cp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % cp.degree != 0:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"{cp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
            )
        dp_world_size //= cp.degree
    if tp is not None:
        if tp.degree < 1 or dp_world_size % tp.degree != 0:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"{tp.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
            )
        dp_world_size //= tp.degree
    if ep is not None:
        if ep.degree == 0 or dp_world_size % ep.degree != 0:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"{ep.__class__.__name__}.degree must be at least 1 and divide into the world size"
            )
        if tp is not None:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                "expert parallelism is mutually exclusive with tensor parallism"
            )
        # With HSDP we just reuse the 'dp_shard' dimension for expert sharding.
        if dp.name != DataParallelType.hsdp:
            dp_world_size //= ep.degree

            # TODO: remove this restriction once DTensor supports cross-mesh operations.
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                "expert parallelism can currently only be used with HSDP data parallelism"
            )

    # Build up mesh dimensions.
    names: List[str] = []
    dims: List[int] = []

    # Pipeline parallel first.
    if pp is not None:
        names.append(MeshDimName.pp)
        dims.append(pp.degree)

    # Then data parallel.
    if dp.name == DataParallelType.hsdp:
        num_replicas, shard_degree = dp.get_replicate_and_shard_degree(dp_world_size)
        names.append(MeshDimName.dp_replicate)
        dims.append(num_replicas)
        names.append(MeshDimName.dp_shard)
        dims.append(shard_degree)

        # Expert parallel.
        if ep is not None:
            # We just reuse the 'dp_shard' dimension for expert sharding.
            if ep.degree >= 0 and ep.degree != shard_degree:
                raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                    "expert parallelism + HSDP requires the same sharding degree"
                )
    else:
        names.append(MeshDimName.dp)
        dims.append(dp_world_size)

        # Expert parallel.
        if ep is not None:
            names.append(MeshDimName.ep)
            dims.append(ep.degree)

    # Context parallel.
    if cp is not None:
        names.append(MeshDimName.cp)
        dims.append(cp.degree)

    # And lastly tensor parallel.
    if tp is not None:
        names.append(MeshDimName.tp)
        dims.append(tp.degree)

    mesh = init_device_mesh(device_type, tuple(dims), mesh_dim_names=tuple(names))
    log.info(f"Built {get_device_mesh_info(mesh)}")

    # Ensure data parallel process group is created here.
    get_dp_process_group(mesh)

    _WORLD_MESH = mesh

    return mesh


def get_device_mesh_info(device_mesh: DeviceMesh) -> str:
    """
    Get a human-readable string representation of a ``DeviceMesh``.

    :param device_mesh: The device mesh to get info for.
    """
    shape: str
    if device_mesh.mesh_dim_names is not None:
        shape = ", ".join(
            f"{dim_name}={d}" for dim_name, d in zip(device_mesh.mesh_dim_names, device_mesh.shape)
        )
    else:
        shape = ", ".join(f"{d}" for d in device_mesh.shape)
    if device_mesh.ndim == 1:
        shape += ","
    return f"{device_mesh.ndim}D device mesh with shape ({shape})"


def build_expert_parallel_mesh(
    ep_config: ExpertParallelConfig, device_type: Optional[str] = None
) -> DeviceMesh:
    device_type = device_type or get_default_device().type
    world_size = get_world_size()

    # Build up mesh dimensions.
    names: List[str] = []
    dims: List[int] = []

    ep_degree = ep_config.degree
    if ep_degree < 0:
        ep_degree = world_size

    if world_size % ep_degree != 0:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            f"Expert parallelism requires world size ({world_size}) to "
            f"be divisible by 'degree' ({ep_degree})"
        )
    names.append(MeshDimName.ep_replicate)
    dims.append(world_size // ep_degree)

    names.append(MeshDimName.ep_shard)
    dims.append(ep_degree)

    mesh = init_device_mesh(device_type, tuple(dims), mesh_dim_names=tuple(names))
    log.info(f"Built {get_device_mesh_info(mesh)}")

    return mesh


def _get_model_mesh(device_mesh: DeviceMesh) -> Tuple[DeviceMesh, Tuple[str, ...]]:
    if (dim_names := device_mesh.mesh_dim_names) is None:
        raise RuntimeError("could not determine DP model sub-mesh without dimension names")

    # Expert parallel dims get flattened into a DP dimension.
    if MeshDimName.dp in dim_names and MeshDimName.ep in dim_names:
        device_mesh, dim_names = _flatten_dims(
            device_mesh,
            MeshDimName.dp,

            name=MeshDimName.dp_ep,
            dim_names=dim_names,

    elif MeshDimName.ep_replicate in dim_names and MeshDimName.ep_shard in dim_names:
        device_mesh, dim_names = _flatten_dims(
            device_mesh,
            MeshDimName.ep_replicate,
            MeshDimName.ep_shard,
            name=MeshDimName.dp,
            dim_names=dim_names,

    # Context parallel dimension gets flattened into the adjacent DP dimension.
    # NOTE: We do this because for param-synchronization purposes a CP group behaves like an extra
    # DP replica set. CP splits the context across ranks but every CP rank still holds a copy of
    # the model parameters. Gradients need to be reduced across the union of DP ranks and CP ranks.
    if MeshDimName.cp in dim_names:
        last_dp_dim = dim_names[dim_names.index(MeshDimName.cp) - 1]
        assert last_dp_dim.startswith("dp")

# We'll initialize this lazily when the trainer is attached, since we need to know
        # the global batch size in order to determine the number of pipeline micro-batches.
        self._train_pp_schedule: Optional[PipelineSchedule] = None
        self._pp_stages: Optional[List[PipelineStage]] = None
        self.pp_mesh = get_pp_mesh(self.world_mesh)
        self.pp_group = self.pp_mesh.get_group()
        self.pp_group_rank = get_rank(self.pp_group)
        self.pp_group_size = get_world_size(self.pp_group)
        self.pp_prev_rank = (self.pp_group_rank - 1) % self.pp_group_size
        self.pp_next_rank = (self.pp_group_rank + 1) % self.pp_group_size
        self.pp_final_stage_rank = self._pp_config.final_stage_rank()
        pp_p2p_group = pp_config.build_p2p_process_group(self.world_mesh)

        # Capture num_flops_per_token from the full unsplit model before split_model deepcopies
        # and drops layers. Under PP each rank only holds its pipeline stage's layers, so querying
        # model_parts would undercount. When the model is on meta device (the common case for PP)
        # this reference has no memory cost.
        self._full_model_num_flops_per_token = model.num_flops_per_token

        # Split model into pipeline stages.
        stages, model_parts = pp_config.split_model(
            model,
            pp_mesh=self.pp_mesh,
            device=self.device,
            use_ddp=(self.dp_world_size > 1 and dp_config is not None and dp_config.name == "ddp"),
            p2p_group=pp_p2p_group,
        )
        self._pp_stages = stages
        log.info(
            f"Applied pipeline parallelism to the model with {get_device_mesh_info(self.pp_mesh)}"
        )

        # Parallelize model parts.
        self.model_parts: List[Transformer] = parallelize_model(
            model_parts,
            world_mesh=self.world_mesh,
            device=self.device,
            max_sequence_length=max_sequence_length,
            rank_microbatch_size=rank_microbatch_size,
            compile_model=compile_model,
            float8_config=float8_config,
            dp_config=dp_config,
            tp_config=tp_config,
            cp_config=cp_config,
            ep_config=ep_config,
            ac_config=ac_config,
            pp_enabled=True,
        )

        self._dp_config = dp_config
        self._cp_config = cp_config
        self._tp_config = tp_config
        self._ep_config = ep_config
        self.label_ignore_index = label_ignore_index
        self.z_loss_multiplier = z_loss_multiplier
        self.rank_microbatch_size = rank_microbatch_size
        self.max_sequence_length = max_sequence_length
        self.autocast_precision = autocast_precision
        self.max_grad_norm = max_grad_norm
        self.scheduler = scheduler
        self.state_dict_save_opts = state_dict_save_opts or dist_cp_sd.StateDictOptions(
            flatten_optimizer_state_dict=True, cpu_offload=True
        )
        self.state_dict_load_opts = state_dict_load_opts or dist_cp_sd.StateDictOptions(
            flatten_optimizer_state_dict=True, strict=False
        )
        self.load_key_mapping = load_key_mapping
        self.eval_only = eval_only

        # Build optimizer(s) — skipped in ``eval_only`` mode (no backward, no step).
        # NOTE: parallelize_model() above still runs because PP/FSDP/HSDP wrapping is required for
        # param sharding even at eval time. Only the optimizer construction is skipped here.
        self.optimizers: List[Optimizer] = []
        if not self.eval_only:
            log.info("Building optimizer(s)...")
            for model in self.model_parts:
                _assert_no_unowned_fp8_weight_stores(model)
            self.optimizers = [optim.build(model, strict=False) for model in self.model_parts]
        else:
            log.info("Skipping optimizer build because eval_only=True")

        if not self.optimizers:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{type(self).__name__} was built with eval_only=True and has no optimizers"
            )

class TransformerPipelineParallelConfig(PipelineParallelConfig):
    """
    Transformer-specific pipeline parallel config.
    """

    use_custom_stage_implementation: bool = False
    """
    False -> use PyTorch's ``PipelineStage`` implementation.
    True -> use :class:`~olmo_core.train.train_module.transformer.pipeline.pipeline_schedule.CustomPipelineStage`,
    which re-uses receive buffers across micro-batches.
    """

    save_schedule_plot: bool = False
    """
    If ``True``, rank 0 saves a diagnostic plot (and text dump) of the pipeline schedule when it is
    built. Requires ``matplotlib`` (the ``dev`` extra), so it is off by default.
    """

    schedule_plot_dir: Optional[str] = None
    """
    Directory for the schedule plot when :data:`save_schedule_plot` is set. Defaults to a temporary
    directory.
    """

    split_points: Optional[List[int]] = None
    """
    A list of unique, increasing block indices that define how to split the model into stages.

    For example, ``split_points = [0, 2]`` with a 4-layer model means the model will be split into
    3 stages, with the first containing just the embedding, the second containing blocks 0 and 1,
    and the third containing blocks 2 and 3 and the language modeling head.

    If not specified the split points are determined automatically based on the schedule type.
    """

    def get_split_points(self, n_layers: int) -> List[int]:
        if self.split_points is not None:
            return self.split_points

        # Multi-stage schedules support more than 2 stages per rank, but this is the default if
        # no pipeline split is specified.
        num_stages_per_rank = 1 if self.schedule.is_single_stage else 2
        total_stages = self.degree * num_stages_per_rank
        num_layers = n_layers
        if total_stages > num_layers:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError("Total stages cannot be greater than the number of layers")

        base_interval = num_layers // total_stages
        extra_layers = num_layers % total_stages

        splits: List[int] = []
        current_layer = 0
        for i in range(total_stages - 1):
            if i == 0:
                current_layer += base_interval
            else:
                # Middle stages get an extra layer if there are any remaining
                if extra_layers > 0:
                    current_layer += base_interval + 1
                    extra_layers -= 1
                else:
                    current_layer += base_interval
            splits.append(current_layer)
        log.info(f"Auto generated pipeline split points will be {splits}")
        return splits

    def split_model(
        self,
        model: Transformer,
        *,
        pp_mesh: DeviceMesh,
        device: torch.device,
        use_ddp: bool = False,
        p2p_group: Optional[dist.ProcessGroup] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[List[PipelineStage], List[Transformer]]:
        if self.p2p_backend != PipelineP2PBackend.nccl and not self.use_custom_stage_implementation:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"p2p_backend={self.p2p_backend.value!r} requires use_custom_stage_implementation=True"
            )

        custom_schedules = {
            PipelineScheduleType.custom_1F1B,
            PipelineScheduleType.custom_interleaved_1F1B,
            PipelineScheduleType.custom_1F1B_V,
        }
        if self.schedule in custom_schedules and not self.use_custom_stage_implementation:
            # The custom schedule driver expects CustomPipelineStage (e.g. `group_size`,
            # `get_fwd_send_ops`); pairing it with torch's PipelineStage fails in pre_train / step.
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"pipeline schedule {self.schedule.value!r} requires use_custom_stage_implementation=True"
            )

        split_points = self.get_split_points(model.n_layers)
        num_stages = len(split_points) + 1

        if num_stages > 1 and model.tie_word_embeddings:
            raise NotImplementedError(
                "Pipeline parallelism with tied word embeddings is not supported: the input "
                "embeddings and LM head are placed on different pipeline stages, so they cannot "
                "share a weight."
            )

from typing import Literal, Optional

import pytest
import torch
from torch.distributed import init_device_mesh
from torch.distributed.tensor import Shard, distribute_tensor

from olmo_core.distributed.utils import get_local_tensor, get_world_size
from olmo_core.nn.cross_entropy_loss import CrossEntropyLoss
from olmo_core.testing import requires_multi_gpu, run_distributed_test
from olmo_core.utils import get_default_device


def compute_loss(
    loss_fn: CrossEntropyLoss,
    logits: torch.Tensor,
    labels: torch.Tensor,
    batch_num_tokens_for_loss: Optional[torch.Tensor],
) -> torch.Tensor:
    ce_loss, z_loss = loss_fn(logits, labels, batch_num_tokens_for_loss)

    loss = ce_loss
    if z_loss is not None:
        loss = loss + z_loss

    if loss_fn.reduction != "none":
        assert loss.shape == tuple(), f"{loss}"
    else:
        assert loss.shape == labels.shape
        loss = loss.sum()

    return loss


def run_cross_entropy_loss_parallel(
    compile: bool,
    reduction: Literal["sum", "mean", "none"],
    z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float],
    logits: torch.Tensor,
    labels: torch.Tensor,
    batch_num_tokens_for_loss: Optional[torch.Tensor],
    grad: torch.Tensor,
    expected_loss: torch.Tensor,
):
    # Init device mesh.
    tp_mesh = init_device_mesh("cuda", (get_world_size(),), mesh_dim_names=("tp",))

    # Put tensors on target device and potentially distributed over the device mesh .
    logits = distribute_tensor(
        logits.to(device=get_default_device()).requires_grad_(),
        device_mesh=tp_mesh,
        placements=(Shard(1),),
    )
    labels = distribute_tensor(
        labels.to(device=get_default_device()), device_mesh=tp_mesh, placements=(Shard(1),)
    )
    if batch_num_tokens_for_loss is not None:
        batch_num_tokens_for_loss = batch_num_tokens_for_loss.to(device=get_default_device())
    grad = distribute_tensor(
        grad.to(device=get_default_device()), device_mesh=tp_mesh, placements=(Shard(1),)
    )
    expected_loss = expected_loss.to(device=get_default_device())

    # Initialize loss and apply parallelism.
    loss_fn = CrossEntropyLoss(
        reduction=reduction, compile=compile, z_loss_multiplier=z_loss_multiplier
    )
    loss_fn.apply_tp(tp_mesh, use_local_output=True)

    # Get loss.
    loss = compute_loss(loss_fn, logits, labels, batch_num_tokens_for_loss)

    # Check loss.
    torch.testing.assert_close(loss.detach(), expected_loss)

    # Trigger backward pass.
    loss.backward()
    assert logits.grad is not None

    # Check gradients.
    torch.testing.assert_close(get_local_tensor(logits.grad), get_local_tensor(grad))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "compile, reduction, ignore_shard",
    [
        pytest.param(False, "mean", False, id="default-mean"),
        pytest.param(False, "mean", True, id="mean-ignored-shard"),
        pytest.param(False, "sum", False, id="default-sum"),
        pytest.param(False, "none", False, id="default-none"),
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("normalize_loss", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("z_loss_multiplier", [None, 1e-4])
@requires_multi_gpu
def test_cross_entropy_loss_parallel(
    compile: bool,
    ignore_shard: bool,
    reduction: Literal["sum", "mean", "none"],
    normalize_loss: bool,
    z_loss_multiplier: Optional[float],
):
    B, S, V = 4, 16, 256

    loss_fn = CrossEntropyLoss(
        reduction=reduction, compile=compile, z_loss_multiplier=z_loss_multiplier
    )

    labels = torch.randint(0, V, (B, S), device="cuda")
    logits = torch.randn(B, S, V, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
    labels[0][2] = -100
    labels[2][9] = -100
    labels[3][12] = -100
    if ignore_shard:
        labels[:, : S // 2] = -100
    batch_num_tokens_for_loss = (labels != -100).sum() if normalize_loss else None

    # Get loss.
    loss = compute_loss(loss_fn, logits, labels, batch_num_tokens_for_loss)

    # Trigger backward pass.
    loss.backward()
    assert logits.grad is not None

    run_distributed_test(
        run_cross_entropy_loss_parallel,
        world_size=2,
        backend="nccl",
        start_method="spawn",
        func_args=(
            compile,
            reduction,
            z_loss_multiplier,
            logits.detach().cpu(),
            labels.detach().cpu(),
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss.detach().cpu()
            if batch_num_tokens_for_loss is not None
            else None,
            logits.grad.detach().cpu(),
            loss.detach().cpu(),
        ),
    )

# u7-l2 张量、流水线、上下文与专家并行

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u7-l1）我们弄清了数据并行（DDP/FSDP/HSDP）：**切数据、不切模型**。本讲补齐剩下的四个并行维度，它们都涉及「把模型或序列切开分给不同的 rank」：

1. **张量并行（TP）**：把单个权重矩阵按维度切开，多张卡合力算一个矩阵乘法。
2. **流水线并行（PP）**：把模型按层切成若干段，每段住在一组卡上，数据像流水线一样流过。
3. **上下文并行（CP）**：把输入序列按长度切开，专门对付超长上下文。
4. **专家并行（EP）**：把 MoE 的专家按「个」切开，每张卡放一部分专家。

学完本讲你应该能够：

- 说明 TP/PP/CP/EP 各自切分的对象、引入的通信模式与适用场景；
- 理解多维并行组合时 `build_world_mesh()` 如何划分进程组（网格维度的先后顺序是一条硬规则）；
- 为一个 8 卡（或多卡）训练任务写出组合并行配置；
- 讲清张量并行下 `CrossEntropyLoss` 的跨 rank 归约：为什么规约结果是 `Partial` 而不是 `Replicate`，为什么 mean 归约必须除以**全局**有效 token 数——这是提交 `075a7892d` 修复的真实 bug。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读过 u7-l1（数据并行）。再补几个 PyTorch 分布式概念，它们是理解源码的词汇表：

- **rank / world size**：分布式训练里每个进程有一个编号（rank），进程总数是 world size。8 卡单机通常是 `torchrun --nproc-per-node=8` 拉起 8 个进程。
- **DeviceMesh（设备网格）**：把所有进程组织成一个多维数组的对象。比如 8 个进程可以组织成 `(2, 4)` 的二维网格。网格的每个维度有一个名字（如 `dp`、`tp`），取某个维度的子网格就得到「一个并行维度专属的进程组」。
- **DTensor 与 Placement（布局）**：DTensor 是「分布在网格上的张量」，它用 placement 描述每个 rank 持有的局部张量与全局张量的关系：
  - `Shard(d)`：每个 rank 持有第 `d` 维切出来的一块（拼起来才是完整的）；
  - `Replicate()`：每个 rank 持有一模一样的完整副本；
  - `Partial()`：每个 rank 持有**一部分和**，只有把所有 rank 的值逐元素加起来（all-reduce）才是正确值。**本讲第 4.1 节的主角就是它**。
- **三个集合通信原语**（通俗版）：
  - all-reduce：所有 rank 各出一个数，大家最后都拿到总和（或均值）；
  - all-gather：每个 rank 出自己那块，最后大家都有完整拼接结果；
  - all-to-all：每个 rank 把手里的数据按目的地拆开，各自送往不同 rank，常用于「换一个维度切分」。
- **微批次（micro-batch）**：PP 里把一个训练批切成小块依次流入流水线；也用于 DP 下的梯度累积（u6-l2 已见）。
- **气泡（bubble）**：流水线中某些 rank 因等待邻居而空闲的时间比例。

数学公式本讲用两处：TP 的均值损失 \( \text{mean loss} = \frac{\sum_{\text{rank}} \text{local sum}}{\text{global valid tokens}} \)，以及 PP 的气泡率 \[ \text{bubble} = \frac{p - 1}{m + p - 1} \] （\(p\) 为流水线级数，\(m\) 为微批数）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/tensor_parallel.py` | `TensorParallelConfig` 与 TP 专用的 `SequenceParallel` 包装 |
| `src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/pipeline_parallel.py` | `PipelineParallelConfig`、调度类型枚举、stage 分配逻辑、`PipelineSchedule` 驱动器 |
| `src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/context_parallel.py` | `ContextParallelConfig` 与 cp↔hp（序列分片↔头分片）的 AllToAll 工具 |
| `src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/expert_parallel.py` | `ExpertParallelConfig`（目前极简） |
| `src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/__init__.py` | `build_world_mesh()`：多维并行的进程组划分中枢，以及各 `get_*_mesh()` 取子网格函数 |
| `src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/config.py` | 四个 `Transformer*ParallelConfig` 包装类（含 CP 的 zig-zag/llama3/ulysses 预设、PP 的切分点） |
| `src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/common.py` | `parallelize_model()`：按固定顺序把各并行策略应用到模型上 |
| `src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/pipeline_train_module.py` | `TransformerPipelineTrainModule`：PP 模式下的训练模块（先切模型再并行化） |
| `src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py` | 模型侧的 `apply_tp / apply_pp / apply_cp / apply_ep` 入口 |
| `src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py` | TP 感知的交叉熵损失，`075a7892d` 修复所在地 |
| `src/test/nn/cross_entropy_loss_test.py` | TP 损失的多进程对拍测试（本讲实践的依据） |
| `src/scripts/official/OLMo2/OLMo-2-0325-32B-train.py` | 官方 32B 脚本（纯 HSDP） |
| `src/scripts/official/OLMo3/OLMo-3-1025-7B-long-context.py` | 官方长上下文脚本（HSDP + CP 组合实例） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 张量并行（TP）：TensorParallelConfig 与「按维度切权重」

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

数据并行的每张卡都拿着**完整的模型**；当单个权重矩阵大到一张卡放不下（或放得下但算得太慢）时，就需要张量并行：把矩阵本身切开。

TP 的基本单位是 Megatron 式的「列并行 + 行并行」组合：

- 注意力层的 QKV 投影按**头（head）**切开（每卡拿到若干完整的头），输出投影按同样的头切法切开，两者拼起来一层的通信只需前后各一次 all-reduce；
- 前馈网络（FFN）按**中间维**切开；
- embedding 与 LM head 按**词表维**切开。

因为激活值在 TP 组内沿序列维分片（`Shard(1)`）流动，夹在两个并行线性层之间的 LayerNorm 也要跟着做**序列并行**（每个 rank 只对自己那段序列做归一化，再在内部完成所需的统计量通信）——这就是 `tensor_parallel.py` 里 `SequenceParallel` 类存在的意义。

TP 与其他维度的本质区别：**TP 是「多卡合作算一个算子」，卡间通信发生在每一层的前向/反向里**，因此 TP 组通常要求高带宽互联（NVLink 同机），度数一般不超过 8。这也解释了实践任务里的问题「为什么 attention 适合 TP」：注意力按头切分后各头的计算几乎独立，切分不需要改变数学结果，通信量小且规整。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

给模型开 TP 的整体流程（由 u6-l2 讲过的 `parallelize_model()` 驱动）：

```text
1. build_world_mesh() 建好带 "tp" 维的网格（见 4.5）
2. get_tp_mesh(world_mesh) 取出 TP 子网格
3. model.apply_tp(tp_mesh)：
   a. embeddings        → RowwiseParallel，输出 Shard(1)，权重按词表维切
   b. embedding_norm    → SequenceParallel
   c. 每个 block        → block.apply_tp()：
      - 入口 PrepareModuleInput: 确保激活是 Shard(1)
      - attention / feed_forward → 列并行 + 行并行
      - 各 LayerNorm   → SequenceParallel
   d. lm_head           → w_out 列并行（词表维切），loss 部分做 TP 归约
   e. 若 tie_word_embeddings → 重新把 lm_head 指回切好的 embedding 权重
```

其中 TP 下的交叉熵损失归约（本讲重点，修复于 `075a7892d`）分三步：

1. **序列分片求和**：每个 rank 对自己那段序列的 token 损失求**和**（注意：即使调用者要 mean，底层也先用 sum，见 4.1.3）；
2. **全局归一**：mean 模式下，用 `get_full_tensor()` 把「全局有效 token 数」all-reduce 到每个 rank，再相除；
3. **Partial → Replicate 规约**：每个 rank 手里的标量只是部分和，DTensor 布局标成 `Partial()`，从 `Partial` 变成 `Replicate` 时 DTensor 自动插入一次 all-reduce，所有 rank 才拿到同一个全局损失。

为什么必须这么绕？写成一个公式：设第 \(r\) 个 rank 的局部损失和为 \(S_r\)、局部有效 token 数为 \(n_r\)，则正确均值是

\[ \text{mean loss} = \frac{\sum_r S_r}{\sum_r n_r} \]

而「各 rank 先算自己的均值再平均」得到的是 \( \frac{1}{p}\sum_r \frac{S_r}{n_r} \)——只有所有 \(n_r\) 相等时两者才 coincidentally 相等。一旦某个 rank 的序列段几乎全是 padding（`ignore_index=-100`），后者就会严重失真，甚至当 \(n_r = 0\) 时除零产生 NaN。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**配置类本体**。[tensor_parallel.py:L17-L40](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/tensor_parallel.py#L17-L40)：`TensorParallelConfig` 只有两个字段——`degree`（TP 度数）与 `enable_async`（实验性异步 TP，会打开 torch inductor 的 micro-pipeline 并为 TP 组开启对称内存）。TP 的「怎么切」不写在配置里，而是写在模型的 `apply_tp` 里。

**模型侧入口**。[model.py:L923-L985](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py#L923-L985)：`Transformer.apply_tp()` 先做两项能力检查（EMO 路由不支持 TP；tie 权重 + fused_linear 损失不支持 TP，[L938-L946](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py#L938-L946)），然后按 embedding → blocks → lm_head 的顺序套用并行计划：embedding 用 `RowwiseParallel`（输入 `Replicate`、输出 `Shard(1)`，[L955-L964](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py#L955-L964)）；最后如果权重共享，把被 `parallelize_module` 拆散的 tie 重新接上（[L978-L982](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/model.py#L978-L982)）。

**块级序列并行入口**。[block.py:L167-L177](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/block.py#L167-L177)：每个 block 先用 `PrepareModuleInput` 声明「我要 `Shard(1)` 的输入」，DTensor 若发现输入布局不符会自动插入重分片通信。

**SequenceParallel 包装**。[tensor_parallel.py:L43-L68](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/distributed/parallel/tensor_parallel.py#L43-L68)：在 torch 原生 `SequenceParallel` 之上增加了 `output_layouts` 支持（默认输出 `Shard(sequence_dim)`），并在输出布局不符时异步重分片（`async_op=True`）。

**TP 损失的三段式（修复核心）**。[cross_entropy_loss.py:L152-L215](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L152-L215) 的 `apply_tp()` 注册了三段布局约定：

1. 模块输入：logits/labels 都要求 `Shard(1)`（沿序列维分片，[L160-L166](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L160-L166)）——所以这里的损失是**序列并行**的：每个 rank 用完整词表算自己那段 token 的 CE；
2. 内层输出：reduction 为 none 时保持 `Shard(1)`（逐 token 损失），否则 `Shard(0)`（标量套一个长度 1 的维度，[L177-L192](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L177-L192)）；
3. **外层输出**：[L194-L197](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L194-L197)——这就是修复的那一行：

```python
# Reducing a sharded loss produces a partial sum, which must be reduced across ranks
# before returning a replicated (or local) loss. Declaring it replicated skips that step.
expected_output_layout = Shard(shard_dimension) if self.reduction == "none" else Partial()
```

**前向里的求和与归一**。[cross_entropy_loss.py:L119-L150](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L119-L150)：`forward()` 在 TP 开启时先 `ce_loss.sum()`（把每 rank 的局部损失加成标量），mean 模式下再用 `get_full_tensor((labels != ignore_index).sum())` 拿到全局有效 token 数相除（[L133-L143](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L133-L143)）。注释点破了动机：「对各 rank 的均值再取平均会给有效 token 数不同的分片同等权重」。

两个精妙细节：

- 内层为什么先强制 sum？[L51-L58](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py#L51-L58)：`reduction="sum" if self.tp_enabled and self.reduction == "mean" else self.reduction`——TP + mean 时底层一律算 sum，归一化留到外层用全局计数做；
- 全局计数怎么来的？`labels` 是 `Shard(1)` 的 DTensor，对它做 `.sum()` 得到的天然是 `Partial` 布局的 DTensor；`get_full_tensor()`（[utils.py:L514-L518](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/distributed/utils.py#L514-L518)）调用 `full_tensor()` 触发 all-reduce，让每个 rank 都拿到分母 \(\sum_r n_r\)。分子分母的通信各一次，就这么拼出了正确的均值。

**修复前后的对比**（可用 `git show 075a7892d -- src/olmo_core/nn/cross_entropy_loss.py` 复核）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| reduction=sum 的输出布局 | `Replicate()`（错误声明） | `Partial()` |
| sum 模式结果 | 每 rank 拿到**局部和**，无 all-reduce（2 卡实测 3.03 vs 参考 6.13） | all-reduce 后每 rank 拿到全局和 |
| mean 模式 | 各 rank 先算本地均值（分片全被 ignore 时是 0/0=NaN），且无全局归一 | 局部 sum + 全局有效 token 数归一，全 ignore 分片安全 |

#### 4.1.4 代码实践：从测试反推修复行为（源码阅读型，无需 GPU）

1. **实践目标**：不看结论，仅凭测试用例和源码推断「把 `Partial()` 误标为 `Replicate()` 会发生什么」。
2. **操作步骤**：
